title: Custom Placement Test Template
sourceNote: Template for placement test question bank. Modify or add sections as needed.

sections.label: Grammar & Vocabulary
sections.instructions: Choose the best answer for each question.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence to complete the statement.
The teacher asked the class to _____ their assignments before Friday.

sections.label: Reading
sections.instructions: Read the academic text below carefully and answer the comprehension questions.
sections.passage:
[A] Insert your reading passage here. You can format paragraphs using line breaks and bracketed letters like [A], [B], [C] for reference.

[B] Second paragraph of the reading text containing details, facts, arguments, or examples for candidates to analyze.

questions.prompt: According to Paragraph [A], what is the primary focus of the text?
options: The correct main idea from paragraph A
questions.answer: The correct main idea from paragraph A

sections.label: Listening
sections.instructions: Listen to each audio prompt and answer the questions.

questions.prompt: Where will the teacher workshop take place?
questions.audioScript: Good morning staff. Please note that today's teacher workshop will begin at 9:00 AM in the Main Auditorium. Please bring your notebooks.

sections.label: Writing
sections.instructions: Complete the writing task. Write thoughtful and well-structured paragraphs.

questions.prompt: Some educators believe digital tools improve student engagement, while others argue they cause distractions. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
Write a short paragraph explaining one method you use to give constructive feedback to learners.

sections.label: Speaking
sections.instructions: Record your spoken response for each interview question using your camera and microphone.

questions.prompt: Please introduce yourself and describe your teaching background and your primary subject area.
questions.guidance: Speak clearly for 1–2 minutes. Provide specific examples.

questions.prompt: Describe how you handle a situation where students have different levels of English proficiency in the same classroom.
questions.guidance: Explain your differentiation strategies and classroom management approach.
